name: Window Fan
description: A window-switcher mode: fan every window on the focused screen against the screen's edges so each keeps a full, always-visible edge no other window can cover -- whatever is on top. Stay in the mode with every window live-bordered (the selected one bold), click any to switch or step through them from the keyboard; press again to leave and restore. Because a window cannot shrink below its own minimum size, the fan declines to run when the screen holds more windows than it can honestly fit, and says how many that is.
